主要内容: On December 31, 2020, Novavax, Inc. entered into an advanced purchase agreement with the Commonwealth of Australia for 51 million doses of its vaccine candidate NVX-CoV2373. The agreement allows for additional orders up to 10 million doses. The company aims to secure regulatory approval from the Therapeutic Goods Administration in Australia and deliver monthly shipments until the doses are fully provided. The agreement permits cancellation by the customer if the company fails to meet supply requirements. The agreement can be terminated if regulatory approval is not obtained or if there is a material breach. It will end upon the conclusion of the pandemic, three years from its effective date, or after 51 million doses are delivered. The agreement is referenced in the company’s 2020 Annual Report on Form 10-K and will be filed with the SEC as an exhibit. It was signed by John A. Herrmann III on January 7, 2021.
